segments.he: מַרְחִיקִין אֶת הַזְּרָעִים וְאֶת הַמַּחֲרֵישָׁה וְכוּ׳. זְרָעִים – תִּיפּוֹק לֵיהּ מִשּׁוּם מַחֲרֵישָׁה! בְּמַפּוֹלֶת יָד.
segments.en: § The mishna teaches: «One must distance seeds,» i.e., one may not plant seeds, «and» one may not operate «the plow,» and one must eliminate urine, three handbreadths from the wall of another. The Gemara asks: Why is it necessary to mention «seeds?» Let him «derive this» requirement to distance the seeds «due to» the requirement to distance «a plow,» as in any event the ground must be plowed before it can be sown? The Gemara answers: This is referring to planting «with a single hand motion,» which is performed without plowing.
